verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a terminal app, so grouping sessions and broadcasting commands is a fair axis. The evidence only shows independent windows (`newWindow`, each with its own context and history). The one cross-window feature is `config --theme -g`, which applies a theme to every open window; that is an appearance setting, not command broadcast, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can group multiple terminal sessions together and broadcast the same command to all of them
